resources.string: Scan the setup QR code from dmh qr, or enter the API endpoint and API key of your deployment. The key is encrypted on this device; you confirm with your fingerprint or screen lock to save it.

Enter an https URL, such as https://abc123.execute-api.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com
Set a screen lock (PIN, pattern or password) in Settings first. The API key can only be stored on a device that has one.
